The <b>Bellhome</b> is a building within the town of [[Bellhart]] restored after the completion of the <i>[[Bellhart's Glory]]</i> [[Wishes|wish]]. After completing the wish and at least [[Bellhome_Key#How_to_Acquire|two other wishes in Bellhart]], speaking to [[Pavo]] will reward [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] with the [[Bellhome Key]] as a reward for her good deeds.

== Use ==
Available by default is a bed that functions as a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]], which Hornet lies down on if no input is made for 4 seconds while resting, or when loading the [[Save Data (Silksong)|save profile]] after resting on the bed. Also available by default is a shelf that at first serves a purely decorative purpose, however once Hornet begins acquiring [[Mementos]] in [[Act 3]], they are displayed on the shelf and can be inspected at any time by interacting with it. This function is later combined with the Desk and the Materium once they are acquired.<br>
Additional functions can be acquired for the bellhome by purchasing the furniture from [[Frey]] and finding certain items around Pharloom that are installed within the bellhome once Hornet returns to it.

== Location ==
The bellhome is located at the top of Bellhart, only appearing and able to be interacted with once the <i>Bellhart's Glory</i> wish is completed.
